events_seen: TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).
CUT (May 11): Jake released Evan Hull (RB, HOU).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: The Deepwater situation has clarified considerably. What I can tell you now: the direction Mitchum has identified involves moving a significant asset, not acquiring one. This is a selling posture. Multiple sources. More when it's filed.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Dina just said Mitchum is in SELL MODE and nobody on this network is screaming about it yet. DEEP is at $68.70, sliding, and the CEO is apparently ready to break the whole thing apart. Give me a segment. I need a segment right now.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Ranking the 2026 offseason narratives and 'Adam traded a 2028 first and C.J. Stroud for Justin Herbert' keeps landing in my Hate column no matter how many times I reframe it. The roster construction is elegant. The price is a short story about optimism defeating arithmetic.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Matteo wants to call Herbert a Hate. Fine. I will grant him that — on the cost. The asset itself? A championship-window quarterback in a superflex format is not a luxury. It is the entire argument. Helix needed a QB. Helix got one. The invoice is painful. The alternative was worse.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: EchoPoint at $105.22, elite RB room, zero TE production — that roster is a sentence with a period missing. Jake has the verbs. Jake has no punctuation. Until that TE desk gets addressed, ECHO is a story I cannot finish reading.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: People are suddenly very interested in whether Sovereign's pick stockpile ever converts to production. Preseason I said the discount would widen every month Wingard didn't move. SDR is flat, the league has moved on, and the 2027 firsts are worth less in a vacuum than people think. Still waiting for the correction.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: While everyone debates the Herbert invoice, can we spend thirty seconds on what Adam actually built behind him? Keaton Mitchell on a real LAC offense, Cyrus Allen developing under Reid, Gyllenborg at TE in a premium format. The supporting cast at Helix is not an accident. Someone built that shelf on purpose.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Hot take and I will not be taking questions: ForgeHammer relocating to Havana is a genius competitive move. Regulatory flexibility is just another term for not having to explain your trades to anyone. Fronge is simply playing in a different timezone. Literally.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tonight on the Exchange Report: Dina's Deepwater sourcing has a direction now, and it is not the one the market was pricing in. Plus — Terrence and Matteo did not resolve the Herbert debate yesterday, so we are finishing it on air whether they are ready or not. Eight o'clock.
